# ruby-mailchecker

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

Cross-language temporary (disposable/throwaway) email detection library. Covers 1979 fake email providers. http://twitter.com/FGRibreau

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/FGRibreau/mailchecker
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/ruby-mailchecker/6.0.21
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/ruby-mailchecker
